content: Expectation Inference & Model Training. Our probabilistic model takes crowd-contributed labels and the model trained in the previous iteration as input. As output, it generates a keyword-specific expectation, denoted as $e^{(t)}$, and an improved version of the micropost classification model, denoted as $p_{\theta ^{(t)}}(y|x)$. The details of our probabilistic model are given in Section SECREF3.
